# IdeaBuddy

> > IdeaBuddy is an all-in-one AI-powered business planning platform that helps entrepreneurs validate ideas, create financial projections, and build investor-ready business plans.

IdeaBuddy combines AI-assisted planning tools with comprehensive business planning features, serving startups, entrepreneurs, business schools, and accelerators. The platform offers both a full suite of planning tools and free standalone AI generators for idea development and business naming.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered business planning
- Business plan builder
- Financial planning & forecasting
- Idea validation & scoring
- AI Buddy (AI assistance)
- Business model canvas
- Startup planning tools
- Entrepreneurship
- Business plan templates
- Free AI generators
- Cash flow projections
- Investor-ready plans
- Business idea generation
- Financial planning software
- Business name generation

## Core Platform

- [IdeaBuddy Home](https://ideabuddy.com): AI-powered all-in-one business planning platform
- [Product Tour](https://ideabuddy.com/features/product-tour): Build your dream business with our all-in-one business planning software
- [Pricing](https://ideabuddy.com/pricing): IdeaBuddy pricing plans with flexible subscription tiers and free trial

## Planning & Building Features

- [Business Plan Builder](https://ideabuddy.com/features/business-plan): AI-powered business plan builder for creating investor-ready plans
- [Financial Planning](https://ideabuddy.com/features/financial-plan): AI-powered financial planning with automatic calculators and cash flow projections
- [Business Idea Plan](https://ideabuddy.com/features/idea-plan): One-page business model canvas for quick idea planning and definition
- [Business Planning Guide](https://ideabuddy.com/features/business-guide): Step-by-step business planning guide with AI assistance and validation tools

## AI-Powered Tools

- [AI Assistance](https://ideabuddy.com/features/ai-assistance): AI Buddy: AI-powered business plan generation and strategy building
- [AI Templates](https://ideabuddy.com/features/ai-templates): AI-generated business plan templates tailored to specific business ideas
- [Idea Validation](https://ideabuddy.com/features/idea-validation): Idea validation tool that scores business opportunity strength

## Free AI Tools

- [Free AI Tools Hub](https://ideabuddy.com/free-ai-tools): Collection of free AI tools: idea, plan, name generators and more
- [Business Idea Generator](https://ideabuddy.com/free-ai-tools/business-idea-generator): Free AI-powered business idea generator for entrepreneurial inspiration
- [Business Plan Generator](https://ideabuddy.com/free-ai-tools/business-plan-generator): Free AI-powered business plan generator for simple startup planning
- [Business Name Generator](https://ideabuddy.com/free-ai-tools/business-name-generator): Free AI business name generator for unique, creative brand naming
